Api._comment: Single source of truth for this environment's own externally-reachable API URL — Program.cs derives Jwt:Issuer (host) and the CORS-allowed origin (scheme+host) from this instead of configuring them separately. Also the value frontend/lib/services/api_config.dart and admin/.env.development point at for local dev.

Encryption._comment: Dev-only key, safe to commit. Production key comes from a secrets manager/env var — never from this file.

Jwt._comment: Dev-only signing key, safe to commit. Production key comes from a secrets manager/env var. Issuer is deliberately not set here — Program.cs derives it from Api:PublicBaseUrl above.

Firebase._comment: Not configured locally — /auth/session will throw a clear error until a real service account JSON is provided via CredentialsPath.

Auth._comment: POST /auth/dev-login accepts any phone number with OTP '123456' — Program.cs refuses to start with this true outside Development.
